invariants.rationale: The method always dereferences 'config', so it must be non-null at the exit.
The method always returns a non-null Option value (Option.empty() or Option.of(...)).
If 'populateMetaFields' is true, returns Option.empty(); otherwise, Option.of(...).
If 'populateMetaFields' is false, returns Option.of(...); otherwise, Option.empty().
